elements.name: Style anchor: the frog on its post, beach at dusk
elements.notes: Key frame that fixes the look: logo sticker + cel shading, the party in the back. Becomes the reference image for everything after.

prompts.text: Logo frog standing in a ready stance on the mooring post, both katanas out to the sides, beach at dusk, beach bar with string lights + disco ball + dancing animal silhouettes; sticker look + cel shading; dark low-contrast background; 16:9, empty sky above.

Same frog leaping off the post mid crossing slash, smear arc + speed lines, squash-and-stretch, wild battle grin, watermelon/pineapple/orange flying, one sliced with juice; beach party at dusk behind; 16:9; bold, no gore.
Same frame as the anchor; frog stays on the post in a deep battle crouch, katanas crossed overhead in an X with a glint, wild toothy grin, tiny pupils, sweat bead, speed lines + dust burst.

Same scene and camera; frog sprung above the post mid-slash with a white smear arc, watermelon cut in two (rind outside, flesh on the cut face seen slightly from the side), orange tumbling, manic grin, animals cheering.

Edit of the anchor, unhinged redefined as max expression inside the faithful style: battle-ready pose, one katana high, one level at the viewer, eyes narrowed, V pressed harder, closed confident smirk, bandana tails curling. No speed lines/glow.

Edit of the anchor: follow-through after a cut on the post, watermelon halves (rind + flesh face seen from the side) in the same flat cel style, sideways glance with one eye narrowed, smug closed smile. No speed lines/glow/smear.

elements.name: Far layer: sky and the beach bar
elements.notes: Back depth: dusk-to-night sky and the empty beach (the party is its own piece, 5.5). Dark and low-contrast so fruit reads. Static, vectorized.

prompts.text: Edit of the anchor: remove frog, katanas, post and ripples; continue sky, sea and beach; keep everything else. Clean plate, to be split locally into 5.1 far (sky, beach, bar) and 5.2 sea.

Same clean plate with the party at max expression in the same style: more string lights to palm trees, paper lanterns, bonfire with dancers, more party animals, disco light spots on the sand, tiki torches.

candidates.note: animate partying animal silhouettes, and lights, get more party members

elements.name: Middle layer: the sea
elements.notes: The body of water between the post and the beach: sea-bound fruit falls into it behind the frog. Static, vectorized. Built together with 5.1: the sea is part of the plate (one image).

elements.name: Near layer: foreground decorations
elements.notes: First plan: shallows, pebbles, foam line, maybe drink cups in the sand. In front of the sea, behind the frog. Must work from a 390 px phone to a wide monitor (shore line at a fixed height from the bottom).

elements.name: Mooring post
elements.notes: Weathered wood post the frog stands on; stretches in height; in the shallows.

elements.name: The party: beach bar and crowd, placed by screen shape
elements.notes: Its own cut-out piece on the beach line of the far layer (Marek 2026-11-18: "the party can be dynamic, it can move with ratio change"): far right on wide screens, nearer the middle on a phone held upright, never behind the frog. Cut from the picked background plate; 5.1 then becomes the empty sky and beach.

elements.name: Party dancers: animated animal silhouettes
elements.notes: Sprite sheet, two dance frames per animal, cut from a flat magenta background; placed on the party set and looped (Marek 2026-11-18: animate the dancers and lights, more party guests). The string lights twinkle in code.

elements.name: Frog, base rig
elements.notes: traced from `static/img/cfpninja_full.png` (see `SPEC.md`), layered: head, eyes, pupils, brow V, bandana knot and tails, torso, each arm with hand, each katana, legs, ground shadow

prompts.text: Module key piece: in-game frog sprite, full body, front, ready stance, katanas out level, on magenta.
Same sprite at max expression in the faithful style: deeper stance, one katana high, one level at viewer, fierce narrowed eyes, closed smirk, tails flicking.
